sets.title: Held-out (10 unseen)
sets.note: Ten reports collected after the prompts were frozen (commit 80b9d59). Nothing was tuned on them. One case was not scored: the test harness could not create the first user on release 0.24.4, before Reenact ran. Retries are on: when the first run does not reproduce the bug, Reenact runs once more.
